headword: {多国籍企業|たこくせききぎょう}

definitions.explanation: A company that owns or controls operations, factories, or subsidiaries in more than one country. Built from {多|た} (many) + {国籍|こくせき} (nationality) + {企業|きぎょう} (enterprise).

examples.japanese: {多国籍企業|たこくせききぎょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work for a multinational corporation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{多国籍企業|たこくせききぎょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: This multinational corporation has factories all over the world.

examples.japanese: {多国籍企業|たこくせききぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{課税|かぜい}→課税：00203_kazei⟧をめぐって、⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{協議|きょうぎ}→協議：02635_kyougi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Countries are continuing talks over the taxation of multinational corporations.

notes:
A standard term in business and economics for a firm operating across national borders.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{巨大|きょだい}→巨大：02586_kyodai⟧{多国籍企業|たこくせききぎょう}: a giant multinational
- {多国籍企業|たこくせききぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進出|しんしゅつ}→進出：14387_shinshutsu⟧: the entry/expansion of multinationals (into a market)
- {多国籍企業|たこくせききぎょう}⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧: regulation of multinational corporations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国際企業|こくさいきぎょう}: international company — emphasizes cross-border business generally
- ⟦グローバル→グローバル：10847_guroobaru⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧: global company — a more recent, broader buzzword for firms operating worldwide
